tei:div.tei:p: skur byin gyis rlobs// rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas su gshegs// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsdus// ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad// brtul zhugs rmad byung u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// za hor yul byon shākya'i dge slong mdzad// tshul khrims rnam dag bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes// pha rol phyin pa bcu yi don dang ldan// thar pa'i lam ston u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la sogs bla ma yi// spyan sngar byon nas sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad// thugs dam zhal gzigs mkhyen gnyis mngon du gyur// shes rab blo ldan u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// ye shes mkha' 'gro dge slong kun dga' mos// zhal du gsol nas gsang ba'i pad+mor bton// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur// smin grol mthar phyin u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// bla mas lung bstan u rgyan la sogs pa'i// dur khrod gnas su mkha' 'gros byin brlabs nas// dngos grub mchog thob dgongs pa mngon du gyur// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// shar phyogs mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu// lha lcam man+dā ra ba yum dang bcas// yab yum gnyis med tshe yi dngos grub thob// skye 'chi gnyis spangs u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// rgyal po'i chad pas me la bsregs pa'i tshe// mtsho chen pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbus nyid du// dngos su bzhugs pas thams cad ngo mtshar skyes// rlung sems dbang thob u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du spyod pa mdzad// chu bo gyen bzlog nyi ma rtod la mnan// rdzu 'phrul stag la chibs nas nam mkhar gshegs// grub thob rgyal po u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// bsil ba tshal du brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i tshe// phyi nang bka' srung thams cad dam la btags// 'jig rten dregs pa kun gyis srog snying phul// ma rungs 'dul mdzad u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// na lan+d+ra ru chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// bdud dang mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad nas// zhi bde'i lam la bkod nas shākya yi// bstan pa rgyas mdzad u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// yang le shod du bde gshegs 'dus pa yi// dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe// rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs nas// dngos grub mchog thob u rgyan dus 'drir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// mnga' bdag rgyal pos bod du spyan drangs tshe// 'jig rten dregs pa btul nas bsam yas bzhengs// rgyu 'bras theg chen chos kyi sgron me spar// bod khams mun sel u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// ti sgro bsgrags dang mchims phu la sogs par// mtsho rgyal yum dang gsang spyod mdzad pa'i tshe// snyan brgyud sku gsung thugs kyi gsang sgo phyes// gdul bya smin grol u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// bod yul sgrub gnas gtsug lag khang rnams su// dgongs pa mdzad nas dam chos gter du sbas// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gdul bya skyong bar mdzad// ma 'ongs don mdzad u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// lnga brgya'i dus su khyed kyi gter chos dang*// 'phrad pa'i skyes bu gang zag las can la// dbang bskur lung bstan byin gyis brlab mdzad pa'i// dngos grub mchog stsol u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs/

kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// lho nub rnga yab gling phran yul du byon// zhe sdang gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// gdul bya smin grol mdzad nas mkha' spyod du// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i sprin gyi tshogs dbus su// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bor bzhugs// he ru ka dpal u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// dbang chen spre'u lo sprail zla'i tshes bcu dang*// dus kyi rgyal po tshes bcu thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs kyis// dad ldan skyong mdzad u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// 'gro mgon khyed kyi mtshan mchog rin po che// 'gro ba gang gis mthong thos dran gyur kyang*// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad kun zhi nas// dgos 'dod re skong u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams su// u rgyan pad+ma bye ba phrag brgya'i sku// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i// 'gro don rgyas mdzad u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// u rgyan pad+ma bla ma'i sku gcig la// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bkod pa rdzogs// rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid kyi sku// rgyal sras mchog gtso u rgyan dus 'dir dran// gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rin po che// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i mgon po u rgyan rin po che// zhing khams gnas mchog gang na bzhugs gyur kyang*// thugs rje myur mam̐ldan pa'i lcags kyu yis// bdag sogs khyed kyi gdul byar gyur pa rnams// 'khor ba'i chu bo che las bsgral nas kyang*// u rgyan mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol//
